from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
base=Path.cwd()
roster=json.loads((base/'native-footprint-pass/REGIONS.json').read_text())
byid={p['id']:p for p in roster['pairs']}
def pin(name):
    raw=(base/name).read_bytes();return {'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)}
pins={}
def take(name):
    pins[name]=pin(name);return json.loads((base/name).read_text())
rows=[]
for pair in byid:
    if pair=='F3':
        regions=[['Im4',270,0,360,88]]
        folder='f3-descending-corridor'
        report=folder+'/report.md';verify=folder+'/final-verification.json'
    else:
        regions=byid[pair]['new_regions']
        folder='native-footprint-pass'
        if pair in ['E3','E4','E5']:folder+='/energy345'
        elif pair in ['E8','E9']:folder+='/energy89'
        elif pair in ['F4','F5']:folder+='/force45'
        elif pair in ['F6','F7','F8','F9']:folder+='/force69'
        report=folder+('/report-e45.md' if pair in ['E4','E5'] else '/report.md')
        verify=folder+('/verification-e45.json' if pair in ['E4','E5'] else '/verification.json')
    completed=[]
    for region in regions:
        source,*box=region
        if pair=='F3':names=[folder+'/reader-root.json',folder+'/reader-independent.json']
        elif pair.startswith('F'):names=[f'{folder}/reader-{pair}-{source}-primary.json',f'{folder}/reader-{pair}-{source}-peer.json']
        else:names=[f'{folder}/reader-{pair}-root.json',f'{folder}/reader-{pair}-independent.json']
        readers=[]
        expected=(box[2]-box[0])*2
        for name in names:
            value=take(name)
            if pair=='F3':
                records=value['observations']
                assert len(records)==expected
                assert sorted((x['route'],x['column']) for x in records)==sorted((r,x) for r in ['solid','dash'] for x in range(270,360))
                box_field='f3-descending-corridor/PROTOCOL.md: fixed inclusive columns 270..359, rows 0..87'
            else:
                if 'target_box' in value:
                    declared=value['target_box'];box_field='target_box'
                elif name=='native-footprint-pass/reader-E7-independent.json':
                    declared=value['target_rectangle_half_open'];box_field='target_rectangle_half_open'
                elif name in ['native-footprint-pass/energy345/reader-E3-independent.json','native-footprint-pass/energy345/reader-E4-independent.json','native-footprint-pass/reader-E6-independent.json']:
                    declared=value['coverage']['target_box'];box_field='coverage.target_box'
                else:raise AssertionError('Unsupported explicit target schema: '+name)
                assert declared==box,(name,'box')
                assert set(value['routes'])=={'solid','dash'}
                for records in value['routes'].values():
                    assert [x['x'] for x in records]==list(range(box[0],box[2])),name
                assert sum(map(len,value['routes'].values()))==expected
            readers.append({'path':name,'route_records':expected,'target_source_field':box_field,'human_accepted_field':value.get('human_accepted','not_present'),'physical_support_field':value.get('physical_support','not_present')})
        completed.append({'source':source,'target_box':box,'readers':readers})
    for name in [report,verify]:pins[name]=pin(name)
    rows.append({'pair':pair,'completed_footprints':completed,'report':report,'verification':verify})
for name in ['PROTOCOL.md','NUMERICAL-PROTOCOL.md','HUMAN-REVIEW-GATE.md','HUMAN-SAMPLE-SELECTION.md','human-anchor-observations-2026-10-06.md','human-legend-confirmation-2026-10-07.md','REGISTRATION-STAGE.md','registration-comparison.md','registration-method-review.md','native-footprint-pass/REGIONS.json','historical-applicability/PROTOCOL.md','historical-applicability/report.md','historical-applicability/verification.json','historical-applicability/run01.json','f3-remainder-inventory/report.md','f3-remainder-inventory/reader-root.json','f3-remainder-inventory/reader-independent.json','f3-descending-corridor/PROTOCOL.md','remaining-route-inventory/report.md','remaining-route-inventory/reader-root.json','remaining-route-inventory/reader-force.json','remaining-route-inventory/reader-energy.json','remaining-route-inventory/force-reconciliation.json','remaining-route-inventory/energy-reconciliation.json','manual-envelope-trial/report.md','manual-envelope-trial/source-applicability.json','native-footprint-pass/energy345/reader-E3-independent-corrected.json']:
    pins[name]=pin(name)
assert len(rows)==14
regions=sum(len(x['completed_footprints']) for x in rows)
readings=sum(len(y['readers']) for x in rows for y in x['completed_footprints'])
records=sum(y['route_records'] for x in rows for z in x['completed_footprints'] for y in z['readers'])
assert (regions,readings,records)==(17,34,10840)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'pins':pins,'counts':{'pairs':14,'completed_regions':regions,'original_readings':readings,'original_route_records':records,'record_count_limits':'Annotation coverage counts, not independently observed curves or accepted physical measurements; E3 correction is not an additional original reading.'}},sort_keys=True))
